note: The map-header equivalent (HGSS src/data/map_headers.h: every map header carries a .battleBg). One deliberate binding per map in FULL_WORLD, plus the GardenView context id 'garden'. The resolver refines this with the standing tile (HGSS FieldSystem_GetTerrainFromStandingTile) — a water tile on a town map still gives the water scene, exactly like HGSS's surfing override to BATTLE_BG_OCEAN. battleBackground.test.ts asserts every FULL_WORLD map id is bound here, so a new map fails the test until it is classified.
